remarks: Found by the docs-audit of docs/dev-guide-zh (2026-11-07); documented in docs/app-docs/flows/goods-verify/ai-scope.md + steps.md (search disabled in the guide until fixed). Fix = filter on shelfCode (+ movements part names client-side), or drop the search box.
